consecutive_hold_runs.note: a run = consecutive anchors at which this arm writes no usable target, so the executor carries the previous book unchanged; 0 runs means the arm rebalances at every anchor. A run is attributed to the cell of its START anchor and reported at its true unbroken length, never truncated at the cell edge.
